entities.summary:
Louis of Starhemberg was a key figure in early 19th-century European diplomacy, serving as a confidant to Prince Klemens von Metternich and playing a crucial role in the Congress of Vienna (1815) and the Quadruple Alliance.\n
As a Knight of the Order of the Golden Fleece, Louis was involved in the patronage of the arts, and his connections to the imperial court led to his appointment as Imperial Envoy to the Ottoman Empire.\n
His diplomatic efforts contributed to the stabilization of the European order, particularly in the context of the Concert of Europe, and his legacy as a statesman and diplomat has endured, influencing the development of international relations in the centuries that followed.\n
